Zo populair zelfs dat de Brollers op hem zullen stemmen als nieuwe voorzitter van de leerlingenraad. programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: There is a new hype in the school: skating. Daria thinks skating superstom and wants nothing to do with it. Until she discovers that Olivia also participates and is therefore suddenly super populary. Daria is determined to surpass Olivia and now also wants to learn to skate. She makes every effort to learn the coolest tricks. Because she is only busy skating, she suddenly no longer has time for Esra. He doesn't understand anything, Daria is no longer herself. Will this be fine again? / In de school heerst er een nieuwe hype: skaten. Daria vindt skaten superstom en wil er niks mee te maken hebben. Tot ze ontdekt dat ook Olivia meedoet en hierdoor plots superpopulair is. Daria is vastbesloten om Olivia te overtreffen en wil nu ook leren skaten. Ze zet alles op alles om de coolste tricks te leren. Doordat ze alleen nog bezig is met skaten, heeft ze plots geen tijd meer voor Esra. Die snapt er niks van, Daria is zichzelf niet meer. Komt dit weer goed?

programme.title: Over my body / Over mijn lijf
programme.desc: Kobe Ilsen and Danira Boukhriss are investigating the impact of nutrition on their energy level. What happens to your body when you eat, or do not eat, and how does that influence your daily energy? Kobe takes on the extreme challenge and eats nothing at all for five days, while Danira is instructed to eat only vegetable unprocessed food for a week. Doctor Servaas Binge also starts a process with three Flemish people with only one goal in mind: diabetes -free life. / Kobe Ilsen en Danira Boukhriss onderzoeken de impact van voeding op hun energiepeil. Kobe gaat de extreme uitdaging aan en eet vijf dagen lang helemaal niets, terwijl Danira de opdracht krijgt om een week lang enkel plantaardig onbewerkt voedsel te eten. programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Silver fox / Srebrena lisica
programme.desc: The German Army is pulling out of town. Only Ustasha trendy and strong illegal movement remained. Illegals liquidate one by one agent. Suddenly, SS Captain Brown arrives in the city. Neither the remaining Germans nor the Ustasha police, nor illegals don't know what the Special Mission came to Captain Braun. / Njemačka vojska povlači se iz grada. Ostalo je još samo ustaško redarstvo te jak ilegalni pokret. Ilegalci likvidiraju jednog po jednog agenta. Iznenada, u grad stiže SS kapetan Braun. Ni preostali Nijemci, ni ustaška policija, niti ilegalci ne znaju u kakvu je specijalnu misiju došao kapetan Braun.

programme.title: Lincoln: In the shadow of division / Lincoln: U sjeni podjela
programme.desc: About political position and personality Lincoln. While the issue of all represented slavery is launching fires in the state, Lincoln enters political ring. What is his position on slavery and equality during this period? How is the lawyer from Illinois, nobody knew, reached the White House? / O političkoj poziciji i ličnosti Lincolna. Dok pitanje sve zastupljenijeg ropstva pokreće požare u državi, Lincoln ulazi u politički ring. Koji je njegov stav o ropstvu i jednakosti tokom ovog perioda? Kako je advokat iz Illinoisa, kojeg niko nije ni znao, stigao do Bijele kuće?

programme.title: I am Heath Ledger / Ja sam Heath Ledger
programme.desc: A documentary about the most talented actor of his generation who left us too early. Heath Ledger lived with full lungs, leaving no traces behind him, but completely revealed himself to the audience who loved him. Extravagant, he had the energy and the will felt by people from his environment. This film describes a versatile artist whose talents have spread to various media such as: acting, production, directing, writing script, photographs, painting, music and poetry. Roles: Heath Ledger, Ben Harper, Kim Ledger Recorders: Adrian Buitenhuis, Derik Murray / Dokumentarni film o najtalentiranijem glumcu svoje generacije koji nas je prerano napustio. Heath Ledger živio je punim plućima, ne ostavljajući za sobom samo tragove, već se u potpunosti razotkrivao publici koja ga je voljela. Ekstravagantan, imao je energiju i volju koju su osjetili ljudi iz njegovog okruženja. Ovaj film opisuje svestranog umjetnika čiji su se talenti proširili raznim medijima kao što su: gluma, produkcija, režija, pisanje scenarija, fotografija, slikarstvo, muzika i poezija. Uloge: Heath Ledger, Ben Harper, Kim Ledger Reditelji: Adrian Buitenhuis, Derik Murray

programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Крег Дугъл Маклалън е в ролята на доктор Лусиен Блейк, който се завръща в Баларат, северозападно от Мелбърн, в края на 1950-те години, за да поеме общата медицинска практика на покойния си баща и ролята на полицейски хирург след отсъствие от 30 години. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. Всеки епизод е около час – между 56 и 59 минути.

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E15, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble property of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E15, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Doctor / Doktorice
programme.desc: MATERNAL - (E06, feature series, England, 2023) A series on a humorous, warm and original way shows the problems that employed mothers face. Through a series of funny and moving situations, we gradually find out more about the lives of three doctors who return to work after maternity leave and pandemic. Maryam, Catherine and Helen thought I could have everything - both children and successful careers in healthcare. But no one told them that after the birth of a child, nothing was the same as before. The mind, body, career and relationships change in unimaginable ways, and everyone expects women to simply accept it. For these three friends, who seek to reconcile numerous business and private obligations, life is a daily struggle, but at least they have each other. Dedicated to all women, mothers and health workers all over the world, the series offers a unique insight into the lives of people who maintain our overloaded health systems alive and unbreakable connections that bind them. R.: Rebecca Gatward Ul.: Parmander Note (Dr. Maryam Afidi), Lara Pulver (MS Catherine Macdiarmid), Lisa McGillis (Dr. Helen Cavendish), Tareq al-Jeddal (Callum), Sabina Arthur (Kim) ... / Maternal - (E06, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Serija na duhovit, topao i originalan način prikazuje probleme s kojima se suočavaju zaposlene majke. Kroz niz smiješnih i dirljivih situacija postupno doznajemo više o životima triju liječnica koje se nakon rodiljnog dopusta i pandemije vraćaju na posao. Maryam, Catherine i Helen mislile su da mogu imati sve - i djecu i uspješne karijere u zdravstvu. No nitko im nije rekao da nakon rođenja djeteta više ništa nije isto kao prije. Um, tijelo, karijera i odnosi mijenjaju se na nezamislive načine, a svi očekuju da žene jednostavno to prihvate. Za ove tri prijateljice, koje nastoje uskladiti brojne poslovne i privatne obveze, život je svakodnevna borba, no barem imaju jedna drugu. Posvećena svim ženama, majkama i zdravstvenim radnicama u cijelome svijetu, serija nudi jedinstveni uvid u živote ljudi koji održavaju naše preopterećene zdravstvene sustave na životu i neraskidive spone koje ih vežu. R.: Rebecca Gatward Ul.: Parminder Nagra (Dr. Maryam Afridi), Lara Pulver (Ms Catherine MacDiarmid), Lisa McGrillis (Dr. Helen Cavendish), Tareq Al-Jeddal (Callum), Sabina Arthur (Kim)...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E06, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E06, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E16, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E16, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. programme.title: Truth and lies / Istina i laži
programme.desc: Truth and Lies - (E03, Educational Program, England, 2022) History of humanity is a history of truth and lies. Since ancient times until today, people have used lies to achieve economic, political and personal goals. This battle is run by pencil, keyboard and camera, but also weapons, torture and terror. And continues to relate countless victims. Because, who knows how to use the latest technologies most often can also gain interpretative sovereignty over what the truth is. The six -part documentary series shows that lies have been written history from an international perspective. Through various themes, it illuminates the role of the media in a merciless struggle for the truth. Truth and fabrication are nowhere as close as in religion. Secular interests are carried out under the guise of faith. In the war, lies justify bloodshed and conceal their own motives. Conspiracy theories are used for the outrage of the enemy and the creation of a grandmother. Money plays a special role because it often decides which truth will overcome. When the lies of powerful float to the light of day, scandals are created that not only stir up society, but can also become an incentive for social changes. But there will always be influential, powerful people who shape public opinions and who try to spread their own truth with all means ... / Truth and Lies - (E03, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Povijest čovječanstva povijest je i borbe istine i laži. Od davnina sve do danas ljudi su se služili lažima kako bi postigli ekonomske, političke i osobne ciljeve. Ta se bitka vodi olovkom, tipkovnicom i kamerom, ali i oružjem, mučenjem i terorom. I nastavlja odnositi bezbrojne žrtve. Jer, onaj tko zna kako se najvještije koristiti najnovijim tehnologijama, može steći i interpretativni suverenitet nad onim što istina jest. Šestodijelna dokumentarna serija prikazuje kako se lažima pisala povijest iz međunarodne perspektive. Kroz različite teme osvjetljava ulogu medija u bespoštednoj borbi za istinu. Istina i izmišljotina nigdje nisu tako bliske kao u religiji. Svjetovni se interesi provode pod krinkom vjere. U ratu se lažima opravdava krvoproliće i prikrivaju vlastiti motivi. Teorije urote rabe se za ocrnjivanje neprijatelja i stvaranje babaroge. Novac ima posebnu ulogu jer često odlučuje koja će istina prevladati. Kada laži moćnih isplivaju na svjetlo dana, nastaju skandali koji ne samo da uzburkaju društvo, već mogu postati i poticaj za društvene promjene. No uvijek će biti utjecajnih, moćnih ljudi koji oblikuju javna mišljenja i koji pokušavaju širiti vlastitu istinu svim sredstvima...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E16, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E07, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E07, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S01, E131, feature series, Portugal, 2024) telenovela talks about the life of a beautiful, brave and unbridled 22 -year -old girl Cacau who lives on a property where her parents are Portuguese, Joaquim and Filomena. They are hosts and people of the trust of the rich boss of Justin, a vase of Pereire, also a Portuguese, who is old and ill, and follows the business from Portugal. The best friends of Cacau are Pitty and Guto who help her make the idea that Brazil tasted the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works at the chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia where he loves surf. She is gifted with chocolate manufacturer, and her biggest dream is to get an international degree in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that this is unattainable because her family does not need money for that very expensive course. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala) ... / Cacao - (S01, E131, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E17, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble property of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E17, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Mammals / Sisavci
programme.desc: Mammals - (E07, Nature. Film, England, 2024) This exceptional BBC documentary series offers a fascinating insight into the most successful group of animals, from the tiny Etruscan Rovka to the huge blue -blue whale. Mammals, and favorite animal groups, are on all continents and in every ocean, from ice desolate to the most dense jungle, in the hottest deserts and the darkest depths. programme.title: Truth and lies / Istina i laži
programme.desc: TRUTH AND LIES - (E04, Educational Program, England, 2022) History of humanity is a history of truth and lies. Since ancient times until today, people have used lies to achieve economic, political and personal goals. This battle is run by pencil, keyboard and camera, but also weapons, torture and terror. And continues to relate countless victims. Because, who knows how to use the latest technologies most often can also gain interpretative sovereignty over what the truth is. The six -part documentary series shows that lies have been written history from an international perspective. Through various themes, it illuminates the role of the media in a merciless struggle for the truth. Truth and fabrication are nowhere as close as in religion. Secular interests are carried out under the guise of faith. In the war, lies justify bloodshed and conceal their own motives. Conspiracy theories are used for the outrage of the enemy and the creation of a grandmother. Money plays a special role because it often decides which truth will overcome. When the lies of powerful float to the light of day, scandals are created that not only stir up society, but can also become an incentive for social changes. But there will always be influential, powerful people who shape public opinions and who try to spread their own truth with all means ... / Truth and Lies - (E04, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Povijest čovječanstva povijest je i borbe istine i laži. Od davnina sve do danas ljudi su se služili lažima kako bi postigli ekonomske, političke i osobne ciljeve. Ta se bitka vodi olovkom, tipkovnicom i kamerom, ali i oružjem, mučenjem i terorom. I nastavlja odnositi bezbrojne žrtve. Jer, onaj tko zna kako se najvještije koristiti najnovijim tehnologijama, može steći i interpretativni suverenitet nad onim što istina jest. Šestodijelna dokumentarna serija prikazuje kako se lažima pisala povijest iz međunarodne perspektive. Kroz različite teme osvjetljava ulogu medija u bespoštednoj borbi za istinu. Istina i izmišljotina nigdje nisu tako bliske kao u religiji. Svjetovni se interesi provode pod krinkom vjere. U ratu se lažima opravdava krvoproliće i prikrivaju vlastiti motivi. Teorije urote rabe se za ocrnjivanje neprijatelja i stvaranje babaroge. Novac ima posebnu ulogu jer često odlučuje koja će istina prevladati. Kada laži moćnih isplivaju na svjetlo dana, nastaju skandali koji ne samo da uzburkaju društvo, već mogu postati i poticaj za društvene promjene. No uvijek će biti utjecajnih, moćnih ljudi koji oblikuju javna mišljenja i koji pokušavaju širiti vlastitu istinu svim sredstvima...

programme.title: Endeavour - Young Morse / Endeavour - Mladi Morse
programme.desc: Endeavour - (S03, E03, feature series, England, 2016) In the beginning of June 1967. It turns out that the disappeared Dutch home helper Ingrid Hjort is not a routine investigation as it seemed at first, but pulls endeavors into the competitive world of the Oxford Scientific Community, the Great City Parks, Vecernje Schools. The dignified estate of the Mortmaigne Crevecouer family and the destroyed family with two sisters and brother, each with their own private demons, but united them with a common sense of loss and suspicion of deeper wounds associated with the investigation. When a connection between Ingrid's disappearance and a similar unresolved case of several years ago is detected, it seems that unconventional methods in the investigation will cross the boundaries of police professionalism. Tensioned relationships at the station lead to unexpected conflicts and complicate the matter even more. As the victims are piling up, and the night teenage party on the river is over tragically, Endeavour concludes that in the game of dark forces that they are governing the events of the distance. Thus, Oxford police have found themselves in a tangled club lies and fraud that will threaten them all. R.: Lawrence Gough Ul.: Shaun Evans (DC Endeavour Morse), Roger Allam (di Fred Thursday), Anton Lesser (Chief Superintendent Reginald Bright), Sean Rigby (DS Jim Stanges), Dakota Blue Richards (WPC Shirley Trewlove) ... / Endeavour - (S03, E03, igrana serija, Engleska, 2016) Početak lipnja 1967. Ispostavlja se da slučaj nestale nizozemske kućne pomoćnice Ingrid Hjort nije rutinska istraga kao što se u prvi tren činilo, već vuče Endeavoura u natjecateljski svijet oksfordske znanstvene zajednice, velike gradske parkove, večernje škole i divlju prirodu u okolici grada. Dostojanstveno imanje obitelji Mortmaigne Crevecouer i razorena obitelj s dvije sestre i bratom, od kojih svatko ima svoje privatne demone, ali ujedinjuje ih zajednički osjećaj gubitka i slutnja dubljih rana povezanih s istragom. Kad se otkrije veza između Ingridinog nestanka i sličnog neriješenog slučaja od prije nekoliko godina, čini se da će nekonvencionalne metode u istrazi prijeći granice policijske profesionalnosti. Napeti odnosi u postaji dovode do neočekivanih sukoba i još više kompliciraju stvar. Kako se žrtve gomilaju, a noćna tinejdžerska zabava na rijeci završi tragično, Endeavour zaključi da su u igri mračne sile koje događajima upravljaju na daljinu. programme.title: Sokol's eyes / Oči sokolove
programme.desc: Falcon eyes - (E06, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) The island of Pag. The unique island in the heart of Dalmatia is known for its harsh beauty, rich history and cultural heritage. Due to the storm worn with a resort, the surface of the whole Pag is irresistibly reminiscent of the surface of Mars, and Legend says that the ancient goddess Athens was on the island. On the island, we will get acquainted with the production of Pag lace, which is listed on the UNESCO list of the intangible heritage of humanity. Neda Oros will be told about the tradition of lace. The drone will also fly the north of the island of Pag, which also has gardens of centuries -old Luna olives. The wild olives are a symbol of resistance to storms and stone, and in one such corner of the Mediterranean there is a olive tree over 2000 years. In the midst of summer, the drone shots will also show the harvesting of a salt flower in the fields of Pag Solana. On the island of Pag, miles and kilometers of long drywall, the eternal monument of the heavy life of Pag aspiration, can be found, high enough that the Pag sheep cannot skip them. We will also follow the Ovcar Shepherd in the early morning tour of our herd. Pag is also rich in numerous archeological sites from various periods, among which the sites of ancient times are particularly emphasized. Air recordings will be accompanied by a group of underwater archaeologists that will clean an ancient ship from the 1st century BC in the area of ​​the Archaeological site near Simon. For the first time, testify to the performance of the Pag Tanca seen from the air. This dance, characteristic of its unique male and female costumes, reflects the tradition of this Adriatic jewel and the pride of all its inhabitants. The drone will also take us to the northeast coast of the Gulf of Pag, in a metajno, where we will see from the air what a trail looks like on the Mars field. That the bridges have always merged and that the symbols of the connections are, we will also be convinced by the air recordings of the Pag Bridge. This magnificent bow in the early morning with the sunrise will be reminded of the viewers to stop for a moment and see for a moment of unique beauty of this construction miracle. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Oči sokolove - (E06, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Otok Pag. Jedinstveni otok u srcu Dalmacije poznat je po svojoj surovoj ljepoti, bogatoj povijesti i kulturnoj baštini. Zbog bure nošene posolicom, površina cijelog Paga neodoljivo podsjeća na površinu Marsa, a legenda kaže kako je na otoku stolovala i antička božica Atena. Na otoku ćemo se upoznati s izradom paške čipke koja je uvrštena na Unescovu listu nematerijalne baštine čovječanstva. O tradiciji čipkarstva govorit će nam Neda Oros. Dron će preletjeti i sjever otoka Paga, na kojemu se nalaze i vrtovi stoljetnih lunskih maslina. Samonikle masline simbol su otpora prema buri i kamenu, a u jednom takvom kutku Mediterana smjestilo se i stablo masline staro više od 2000 godina. U jeku ljeta, snimke dronom prikazat će i berbu cvijeta soli na poljima paške solane. Na otoku Pagu mogu se pronaći kilometri i kilometri dugih suhozida, vječni spomenik teškog života paškog težaka, dovoljno visoki da ih paška ovca ne može preskočiti. Pratit ćemo i paškog ovčara u ranojutarnjem obilasku svojeg stada. Pag obiluje i mnogobrojnim arheološkim nalazištima iz raznih razdoblja, među kojima se posebno ističu nalazišta iz antičkog doba. Zračne snimke pratit će skupinu podvodnih arheologa koji će na području arheološkog nalazišta Letavica u blizini Šimuna čistiti antički brod iz 1. stoljeća prije Krista. Po prvi put posvjedočite i izvođenju paškog tanca viđenog iz zraka. Ovaj ples, karakterističan po svojim unikatnim muškim i ženskim nošnjama, odražava tradiciju ovog jadranskog dragulja i ponos svih njegovih stanovnika. Dron će nas odvesti i na sjeveroistočne obale Paškog zaljeva, u Metajnu, gdje ćemo iz zraka vidjeti kako izgleda trail na marsovskom terenu. Da mostovi oduvijek spajaju i da su simboli povezivanja, uvjerit ćemo se i zračnim snimkama Paškog mosta. Taj velebni luk u rano jutro s izlaskom Sunca gledatelje će podsjetiti da na trenutak zastanu i uvjere se u jedinstvenu ljepotu ovog graditeljskog čuda. R.: Filip Filković...

Žarko sanira posljedice ugriza iz psećeg parka, koji su prva neugodna životna lekcija mladom i naivnom njemačkom ovčaru. Kako bi nekim životinjama u ZOO-u uspjela urediti papke, Vesna doslovno mora čekati proljeće i pojavu zelene poslastice zbog koje i najoprezniji grivasti skakači u krdu prilaze na domet puške za uspavljivanje. The historical dimension is joined by the personal memories of the few remaining Kurnatars and tell the story of heritage, culture, relationships, gastronomy, beliefs, shipbuilding, struggle with natural disasters. programme.title: Tandem / Tandem
programme.desc: Tandem - (S04, E09, feature series, France, 2020) a new start and old accounts - the fourth season of the tandem series six months after the drama with a hostage crisis in which Lea was the victim of Rodolphe Meunier, everything changes in Montpellier. The old conflicts, which marked her relationship with the colonel, are finally behind her - this time irreversibly. The colonel left the city to preserve the cheek, and with him the captain Vannier, who released Leo in an attempt to replace it. For the investigative team, a new chapter begins. Lea remains in Montpellier, Paul is happy to be with him, and their cooperation seems harmonious and balanced. But below the surface, Lea hides the secrets that could change everything. The fourth season brings new murders, moral dilemmas and personal turning points, with a question that runs through each episode: Can we change the ones we love - or should we love them exactly as they are? R.: Corinne Bergas Ul.: Astrid Veillon (Lea Soller), Stephane Blancatrat (Paul Marchal), Pierick Tournier (Erwan Lebellec), Baya Rehaz (Inès Zaïdi), Tatiana Gousseff (Sabine Mauriac) ... / Tandem - (S04, E09, igrana serija, Francuska, 2020) Novi početak i stari računi - četvrta sezona serije Tandem Šest mjeseci nakon drame s talačkom krizom u kojoj je Lea bila žrtva Rodolphea Meuniera, u Montpellieru se sve mijenja. Pukovnik je napustio grad kako bi sačuvao obraz, a s njim odlazi i kapetanica Vannier, koja je izdala Leu u pokušaju da je zamijeni.Za istražiteljski tim počinje novo poglavlje. Lea ostaje u Montpellieru, Paul je sretan što je uz njega, a njihova suradnja djeluje skladno i uravnoteženo. No ispod površine, Lea skriva tajne koje bi mogle sve promijeniti.Četvrta sezona donosi nova ubojstva, moralne dileme i osobne prekretnice, uz pitanje koje se provlači kroz svaku epizodu: možemo li promijeniti one koje volimo - ili ih trebamo voljeti upravo takve kakvi jesu? programme.title: Boxer: The Life of Jem Belcher / Boksač: Život Jema Belchera
programme.desc: Prizefighter: The Life of Jem Belcher - (biographer. Film, England, 2022) at the 18th century turn, boxing was considered "royal sport". The gifted young boxer James Belcher (M. Hookings) is fighting for the title of champion of England. He was born in a poor family and was raised by his grandfather (R. Crowe), a former boxer who struggles with addiction. In order to earn a living and pay tribute to his grandfather, he addressed the famous coach (R. Winstone), who brought his raw talent and under whose coaching leadership he became the best boxer of the world. Is, overjoyed that he is finally the champion of England, he experiences an accident in which he partially blinds and thus begins his fall. It must be proven again. He accepts a match with the current champion to regain the title. R .: Daniel Graham Ul.: Matt Hookings (Jem Belcher), Ray Winstone (Bill Warr), Marton Csokas (Lord Rushworth), Jodhi May (Mary Belcher), Russell Crowe (Jack Slack) ... / Prizefighter: The Life of Jem Belcher - (biograf. film, Engleska, 2022) Na prijelazu iz 18. u 19. stoljeće boks se smatrao "kraljevskim sportom". programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia) Shakespeare's classic Romeo and Juliet, like his Hamlet, is an eternal inspiration to many diverse artistic reflections. Thus, the great opera composer Vincenzo Bellini wrote an opera in whose focus he put a conflict between two Veron families and called Capuleta and Montecchi. His opera version of Shakespeare's drama is rarely found on the repertoire because there are no known arias and is very difficult to perform, but this masterpiece is still full of wonderful topics and choral scenes. Therefore, it deserves to be enjoyed by the audience of our time, especially in Split, as a rule, a reluctant early Belkant. On the trail of extension of repertoire views, the title was placed in the program of the season of the Croatian National Theater there by the director of Split Opera Ivan Srbljan. For the conductor of reprise performances and assistant Maestro Ivo Lipanovic, who was preparing the premiere, she chose the best placed Croatian competitor at the conductor of the conductor of Lovro von Matacic, the choir of the Kojdija City Theater, Davor Kelic. The directorial job entrusted to the young and increasingly promising Hrvoje Korbar, to whom this is the second independent opera directing after last year Gotovac's one -piece Stanac in Zagreb. His closest associates are in this production of sculptor and set designer Zdravko Ivandi Kirigin, and painter and costume designer Barbara Bourek who opted for abstract design of historical sources. The crew of the class of classics arrives in Split at the last performance of the season, March 5, 2024, and deals with the compliant division consisting of domestic and guests: Split mezzo -soprano Bjanka Ivas (Romeo), Slovenian soprano Nina Dominko (Julija), Split Bariton Josko Tranfić (Lorenzo), Sinjski bass, Sam Furnes (Tebaldo). The small but powerful team gave her best to present this opera at the best. We recorded their thoughts on the subject ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska) Shakespeareov klasik Romeo i Julija, poput njegova Hamleta, vječna je inspiracija mnogim raznolikim umjetničkim promišljanjima. Tako je veliki operni skladatelj Vincenzo Bellini napisao operu u čiji je fokus stavio sukob dviju veronskih obitelji, te djelo nazvao Capuleti i Montecchi. Njegova se operna verzija Shakespeareove drame rijetko nalazi na repertoaru jer nema poznatih arija i vrlo je teška za izvođenje, no ovo remek-djelo ipak vrvi predivnim temama i zborskim prizorima. Stoga u njemu zaslužuje uživati i publika našeg doba, poglavito u Splitu, u pravilu nesklonom ranom belkantu. Na tragu proširenja repertoarnih vidika naslov je u program sezone tamošnjega Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta smjestila ravnateljica Splitske opere Ivana Srbljan. Za dirigenta repriznih predstava i asistenta maestru Ivi Lipanoviću, koji je pripremao premijeru, odabrala je najbolje plasiranog hrvatskog natjecatelja na dirigentskom natjecanju Lovro von Matačić, inače zborovođu Gradskog kazališta Komedija, Davora Kelića. Redateljski je posao povjerila mladom i sve perspektivnijem Hrvoju Korbaru kojemu je ovo druga samostalna operna režija nakon prošloljetne Gotovčeve jednočinke Stanac u Zagrebu. Njegove su najbliskije suradnice u ovoj produkciji kiparica i scenografkinja Zdravka Ivandija Kirigin, te slikarica i kostimografkinja Barbara Bourek koje su se odlučile za apstraktno oblikovanje povijesnih izvora. Ekipa Svijeta klasike stiže u Split na posljednju predstavu u sezoni, 5. ožujka 2024., te zatiče usklađenu podjelu koju čine domaći i gosti: splitska mezzosopranistica Bjanka Ivas (Romeo), slovenska sopranistica Nina Dominko (Julija), splitski bariton Joško Tranfić (Lorenzo), sinjski bas Božo Župić (Capellio), te velški tenor Sam Furness (Tebaldo). Mala, ali moćna ekipa dala je sve od sebe predstaviti ovu operu u najboljem izdanju. Zabilježili smo njihova razmišljanja na tu temu...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) What makes the life of jazz and jazzists specific in relation to other genres is the amount of importance to encounter new musicians, playing exchange with colleagues you have not had the opportunity to play with before. One such form was presented to us at the end of May 2024. Our Istrian jazz-shot: trumpeter Branko Sterpin, double bass player Vedran Ruzic and drummer Marco Quarantotto, joined by fantastic Slovenian pianist Marko Crncec, all with the aim of hosting the stars of the world jazz in Pula Zenona. The concert of this commemorative quintet, realized on Sterpin's initiative as part of the Jazz Waves program, was also important as an incentive for our musicians, who deserve to gain visibility through such collaborations. Zenon is at the moment in the special focus of the world of Jazz's world: he came to Pula shortly after receiving Grammy for Best Latin Jazz-Album, while in his career he was a scholarshipist of the Macarthur and Guggenheim Foundation, with many other awards. It is first and foremost a virtuoso instrumentalist and a stimulating composer, who offered our excellent musicians an unusual opportunity to expel from the comfort zone. Not unexpectedly, Sterpin, Ruzic, Quarantotto and Crncec showed that there is no lack of musicians in this region who have something to say to their world -class colleagues. All they have to do is give them the opportunity to share the stage with them, as offered to them in Pula - their undeniable talent, effort and willingness to musical exchanges will take care of everything else ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Ono po čemu je život jazza i jazzista specifičan u odnosu na druge žanrove jest količina važnosti koja se pridaje susretu s novim glazbenicima, sviračkoj razmjeni s kolegama s kojima prethodno niste imali prilike zasvirati. Jedan takav oblik prikazale su nam potkraj svibnja 2024. naše istarske jazz-snage: trubač Branko Sterpin, kontrabasist Vedran Ružić i bubnjar Marco Quarantotto, kojima se pridružio fantastični slovenski pijanist Marko Črnčec, a sve s ciljem da u Puli ugoste zvijezdu svjetskog jazza, portorikanskog alt-saksofonista Miguela Zenona. Koncert tog prigodnog kvinteta, realiziran na Sterpinovu inicijativu u sklopu programa Jazz Waves, bio je važan već i kao poticaj našim glazbenicima, koji zaslužuju dobiti na vidljivosti kroz ovakve suradnje. Zenon je naime u ovom trenutku u posebnom fokusu svijeta jazza: u Pulu je došao nedugo nakon što je dobio Grammyja za najbolji latin jazz-album, dok je prethodno u karijeri bio stipendist zaklada MacArthur i Guggenheim, uz brojna druga priznanja. Riječ je prije svega o virtuoznom instrumentalistu i poticajnom kompozitoru, koji je našim izvrsnim glazbenicima ponudio nesvakidašnju priliku za izbacivanje iz zone komfora. Nimalo neočekivano, Sterpin, Ružić, Quarantotto i Črnčec pokazali su da na ovim prostorima ne nedostaje glazbenika koji imaju što reći svojim kolegama svjetskog glasa. Treba im samo dati priliku da s njima podijele pozornicu, kao što im je to ponuđeno u Puli - za sve ostalo će se pobrinuti njihov nesporan talent, trud i spremnost na glazbenu razmjenu...

Možda i najstariji kozmopolitski europski grad, koji su stoljećima generacije naših predaka morale ili htjele smatrati svojim glavnim gradom. Beč. programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia) Today, when we meet with constant new migrants, Robert Perisic reminded us that our civilization is also a consequence of some of the ancient migration. The novel The Issu ship brought us back to the 4th century before our era, in an era where the Illyrians did not want to drink wine brought by the Greeks, as an act of a kind of resistance to the then globalization, while the Greeks of beer considered Barbari. Our guest is Robert Perisic. Kristina Gavran was born in Zagreb and at the last year of dramaturgy studies gets an Erasmus scholarship and goes to professional practice in Birmingham. And now for ten years he has lived and worked in England and the life of a young married couple in that country is the theme of her new novel between ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Danas kada se susrećemo sa stalno novim migrantima, Robert Perišić podsjetio nas je da je i naša civilizacija posljedica nekih davnih migracija. Roman Brod za Issu vraća nas u 4. stoljeće prije naše ere, u doba u kojem Iliri nisu htjeli piti vino koje su donijeli Grci, kao čin svojevrsnog otpora tadašnjoj globalizaciji, dok su pak Grci pivopije smatrali barbarima. Naš je gost Robert Perišić. Kristina Gavran rođena je u Zagrebu a na posljednjoj godini studija dramaturgije dobiva Erasmus stipendiju i odlazi na stručnu praksu u Birmingham. programme.title: What is a classic? / Što je klasik?
programme.desc: What is a classic? - (Cult. Magazine, Croatia) Behind the unusual poetry of Joseph North, there is also an unusual life path. They proclaimed him a blasphemy, a top dreamer of everyday life, a priest of sound and rhythm, a don kihot who rides on a ridge of books. He was the last true bohemian of Croatian literature. He searched for the magic of the language in the verses, and for the passion he publicly performed with, he was called a poetic shaman. The poet who has brought a whole new experience in Croatian poetry, according to stylistics professor, poet and critic, academician Kresimir Bagic and one of his closest friends, writer Ludwig Bauer. R.: Ivo Kuzmanic ... / Što je klasik? - (kult. magazin, Hrvatska) Iza nesvakidašnje poezije Josipa Severa krije se i nesvakidašnji životni put. Proglasili su ga bogotražiteljem, vrhunskim sanjačem svakodnevice, svećenikom zvuka i ritma, Don Kihotom koji jaše na hrptu knjiga. Bio je posljednji istinski boem hrvatske književnosti. U stihovima tragao je za magijom jezika, a zbog strasti s kojom ih je javno izvodio prozvan je poetskim šamanom. O pjesniku koji je donio posve novo iskustvo u hrvatsku poeziju, govore profesor stilistike, pjesnik i kritičar, akademik Krešimir Bagić i jedan od njegovih najbližih prijatelja pisac Ludwig Bauer. R.: Ivo Kuzmanić...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Out of format - (artistic program, Croatia) "We are as good as our last project." These are the words designer Source Juric, who has been present with her team for 25 years on the Croatian and international design scene. After two and a half decades, awards have stopped counting, and the list of designed products is very long. These days, the news came to the public that the Design Bureau was becoming a Dig Studio. What is behind the new name and why he thinks of quality design speaks to a universal language, we will find out from designer Sourcen Juric. R.: Vesna Lukovic Žarno ... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) "Onoliko smo dobri koliko i naš posljednji projekt." Riječi su to dizajnerice Izvorke Jurić koja je sa svojim timom već 25 godina prisutna na hrvatskoj i međunarodnoj dizajnerskoj sceni. Što se krije iza novog imena i zašto smatra da kvalitetan dizajn govori univerzalnim jezikom, doznat ćemo od dizajnerice Izvorke Jurić. R.: Vesna Luković Žarn...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2022) at the European Short Story Festival 2022. After talking with a literary rock star in the Studio, the star in the emergence, Lana Bastašić received the "Capture of the Rabbit" for her first novel, "The Roman Award for Literature, the novel has lived in a shortlist for the NIN award and has been translated into about 20 languages. After him, she published a collection of "Milk Teeth", encouraged five young writers to write a Diary of 2020 with her, and recently published a new book "The Red suitcase". In the continuation of the show, we present another young writer from our neighborhood. Dario Grgic recommends the philosophical novel "The Terrible Children of Averroes" Emine Smailbegovic, writer from Sarajevo, otherwise a musician and musicologist ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2022) Na Festivalu europske kratke priče 2022. nismo mogli propustiti razgovor s kultnim piscem Hanifom Kureishijem o rasi, klasi, seksualnosti, tematici koja ga zaokuplja već 30-ak godina još od slavnog romana "Buddha iz predgrađa". Nakon razgovora s književnom rock-zvijezdom u studiju nas čeka zvijezda u nastanku, Lana Bastašić za svoj je prvi roman "Uhvati zeca" dobila Nagradu Europske unije za književnost, roman je ušao u uži izbor za NIN-ovu nagradu i preveden je na 20-ak jezika. Nakon njega objavila je zbirku priča "Mliječni zubi", potaknula petero mladih pisaca da zajedno s njom napišu dnevnik "2020.", a nedavno je objavila novu knjigu "Crveni kofer". He is the recipient of the Milos Crnjanski Award, Mesa Selimovic, Kocic's Pero and numerous other awards. "Via Pula", the first novel by Dragan Velikać was published in 1988 in Serbian because, as the author says, he did not think about the content of Pula and the language of Belgrade; That was not excluded at the time. Velikic wanted to return Via Pula to her mother's speech, so in the Croatian edition of Roman Paola Orlic, she adapted the text and realized the writer's wish. The novel "Astrana" was published in 1991 in the famous hit Library Zlatko Crnkovic, but then remained confused with a whirlwind of war, so the new edition, three decades later, was the opportunity for the first and to others for a new reading during another, today's current war. Thus, the transformation books in time and the transformation itself have transformed ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Naš današnji gost Dragan Velikić čak je dvaput dobio NIN-ovu nagradu za najbolji roman, za "Ruski prozor" i "Islednika". Velikić je želio "Via Pulu" vratiti materinskom govoru pa je u hrvatskom izdanju romana Paola Orlić adaptirala tekst i ostvarila piščevu želju. Roman "Astragan" objavljen je 1991. u slavnoj Hit biblioteci Zlatka Crnkovića ali tada je ostao zameten vihorom rata pa je novo izdanje, tri desetljeća poslije, jednima prilika za prvo a drugima za novo čitanje u vremenu jednog drugog, danas aktualnog rata. In this show, with the fragments of Solo songs of Rahmaninova, Kunac, Poulenac, Copland and Gershwin, they reveal hidden hopes, desires, secrets, victims, but also the price of their success ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Umjetnici o kojima se proteklih godina mnogo govori, naglo su stigli pod reflektore koncertnih podija, tako da nismo stigli s njima popričati njihovim počecima. Takva se prigoda javila u refleksivnom ozračju njihova zajedničkog recitala koji u organizaciji Hrvatske udruge glazbenih umjetnika, u ciklusu Glazbeni umjetnici Zagrebu, 26. ožujka 2024. ostvaruju sopranistica Darija Auguštan i pijanist Vedran Janjanin. Darija je glazbu tijekom školovanja shvaćala tek rekreativno, svirala je violinu, a onda spontano prešla na solopjevanje. Vedran se s druge strane pokušao opirati utjecaju glazbeničke obitelji (otac pijanist i profesor klavira, sestra jazz skladateljica), da bi na kraju pronašao svoj put kao pijanist sofisticiranog klasičnog repertoara. Darija je danas na pragu svojega svjetskog uspjeha, stalna je članica Zagrebačke opere, ali sve češće gostuje u inozemnim opernim produkcijama. Vedran je produžio svoj poslijediplomski na prestižnoj londonskoj Kraljevskoj akademiji za glazbu. U ovoj emisiji, uz ulomke solopjesama Rahmanjinova, Kunca, Poulenca, Coplanda i Gershwina, otkrivaju skrivene nade, želje, tajne, žrtve, ali i cijenu njihova uspjeha...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2023) In Dear Diklić, we are fortunate to watch and listen to a person who not only lived through a significant part of the contemporary history of our popular music, but in different ways embodies it. The time is Slager, Opatija, Dancers, Big Bands and Jazz. Diklić stepped into this seductive world as a saxophonist and singer, next time who, as an undisputed star, has been awarded by Ivo Robic. Diklić was one of our pioneers baritone saxophones and played in numerous orchestras and compositions at the time. In the meantime, the saxophone has fallen into the background in front of the singing microphone does not mean that he has left jazz aside. He still forms an important part of the tradition that Diklić invokes in various forms, as, after all, the jazz grew music that he celebrated. When he paid tribute to his friend and colleague Ivo Robic in the Zagreb factory in mid -March, his performance was not only a dedication to the golden age of our popular music, but also the proof that new generations like to capture something from his nostalgic glare. R.: Melanija Povic Jagarinec ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2023) U Dragi Dikliću imamo sreću gledati i slušati osobu koja ne samo da je proživjela značajan dio suvremene povijesti naše popularne muzike, nego ju na različite načine utjelovljuje. Doba je to šlagera, Opatije, plesnjaka, big bendova i jazza. Diklić u taj zavodljivi svijet zakoračuje kao saksofonist i pjevač, slijedeći put koji je kao neprikosnovena zvijezda utabao Ivo Robić. Diklić je bio jedan od naših pionira bariton saksofona te je svirao u brojnim tadašnjim orkestrima i sastavima. To što je u međuvremenu saksofon pao u drugi plan pred pjevačkim mikrofonom ne znači da je ostavio jazz po strani. On još uvijek tvori važan dio tradicije na koju se Diklić poziva u raznim oblicima, kao što je, uostalom, iz jazza izrasla glazba kojom se proslavio. Kada je sredinom ožujka u zagrebačkoj Tvornici odao koncertnu počast svom prijatelju i kolegi Ivi Robiću, njegov nastup nije bio samo posveta zlatnom dobu naše popularne glazbe nego i dokaz da nove generacije vole uhvatiti nešto od njegovog nostalgičnog odbljeska. R.: Melanija Pović Jagarinec...

programme.desc: The Art of Architecture - (E05, Educational Program, England, 2019) The series represents some of the most famous architects in the world. We will find out how art affects the great builders of our time, from Santiago Calatrave to Sir David Adjae. We will get acquainted with a variety of projects, from the Batters power plant, through the Vanda Museum in Dundee, Distiliya in Speyside, the National Museum of African American History and Culture in Washington, the remodeled Museum of Design in London, to Vessel, which is not a house, but a magnificent staircase that will soon become a new symbol of Manhattan. Upoznat ćemo se s raznolikim projektima, od elektrane Battersea, preko muzeja VandA u Dundeeju, distilerije u Speysideu, Nacionalnog muzeja afroameričke povijesti i kulture u Washingtonu, preuređenog Muzeja dizajna u Londonu, do Vessela, koji nije kuća, nego veličanstveno stubište koje će uskoro postati novi simbol Manhattana. programme.title: Photos in Croatia / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Photo in Croatia - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2001) Toso Dabac, one of the largest Croatian photographers of the 20th century, has a refined sensibility in the recording of the city's atmosphere, quickly photographic thinking and spontaneity and determination in the framing of the photo. He is most appreciated and remembered for the cycle of "People from the Street" in which he records the crisis of Zagreb's thirties, but also by other, "hedonist" paintings, in which the city always pulses, the vibrancy of the street, passers -by and inscriptions on stores. Despite the thematically colorful oeuvre, often dictated by orders, he is primarily an urban photographer, even more precisely - photographer of Zagreb. He died on May 9, 1970. And behind him remained a photographic story about Zagreb, people, crazy politics and joy of living ... / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2001) Tošo Dabac, jedan od najvećih hrvatskih fotografa 20. stoljeća, posjeduje rafinirani senzibilitet u bilježenju ugođaja grada, brzo fotografsko razmišljanje te spontanost i odlučnost u kadriranju fotografije. Najviše je cijenjen i zapamćen po ciklusu "Ljudi s ulice" u kojem bilježi krizu zagrebačkih tridesetih, ali i po ostalim, "hedonističkim" slikama, u kojima uvijek pulsira grad, živost ulice, prolaznici i natpisi na trgovinama. Unatoč tematski šarolikom opusu, često diktiranom narudžbama, on je prije svega urbani fotograf, čak točnije - fotograf Zagreba. Umro je 9. svibnja 1970. a iza njega je ostala fotografska priča o Zagrebu, ljudima, ludosti politike i radosti življenja...

programme.title: Labyrinth lies / Labirint laži
programme.desc: Im Labyrinth des Schweigens - (Drama, Germany, 2014) Germany 1958 Renewal, Economic Miracle. Johann Radmann (Alexander Fehling) was recently appointed a public prosecutor. Like all beginners, he must be satisfied with boring traffic offenses. Radmann is interested in journalist Thomas Gnielka (Andre Szymanski) causes confusion in the courtroom. Gnielka's friend recognized a teacher who was once a guard in Auschwitz. But no one wants to judge him. Although his superiors are opposed to this, Radmann begins to explore the case. Suddenly he finds himself in a network of repression and denial, but also idealization. At that time, "Auschwitz" was a word that some had never heard, and many wanted to forget her as soon as possible. Only Chief Prosecutor Fritz Bauer (Gert Voss) encourages Radmann's curiosity. He has long wanted to make people aware of the crimes they have committed in Auschwitz, but there is no legal tools to firm. After Johann Radmann and Thomas Gnielka find documents leading directly to the perpetrator, Bauer immediately realizes how important they are and the official investigation entrusts Radmann. The young prosecutor is completely dedicated to this new assignment and is determined to find out what happened. He examines the witnesses, searches the documents, provides evidence, and allows the case to be captured so much that he becomes blind to everything else around him, even to Marlene Wondrak (Friederike Becht), which he fell in love with. Radmann crosses the boundaries, quarrels with friends, colleagues and allies, and goes deeper into the maze of lies and guilt in search of truth. But what will eventually discover will forever change the whole country. R.: Giulio Ricciarelli Ul.: Alexander Fehling (Johann Radmann), Andre Szymanski (Thomas Gnielka), Friederike Becht (Marlene Wondrak), Johannes Krisch (Simon Kirsch), Johann von Bulow (Staatsanwalt Haller) ... / Im Labyrinth des Schweigens - (drama, Njemačka, 2014) Njemačka 1958. Obnova, gospodarsko čudo. Johann Radmann (Alexander Fehling) nedavno je imenovan javnim tužiteljem. Kao i svi početnici, mora se zadovoljiti dosadnim prometnim prekršajima. Radmann se zainteresira nakon što novinar Thomas Gnielka (Andre Szymanski) izazove pomutnju u sudnici. Gnielkin prijatelj prepoznao je učitelja koji je nekoć bio čuvar u Auschwitzu. No nitko mu ne želi suditi. Iako se njegov nadređeni protivi tomu, Radmann počinje istraživati taj slučaj. Odjednom se nađe u mreži represije i poricanja, ali i idealiziranja. U to je vrijeme "Auschwitz" bila riječ koju neki nikada nisu ni čuli, a mnogi su je htjeli što prije zaboraviti. Samo glavni tužitelj Fritz Bauer (Gert Voss) potiče Radmannovu znatiželju. On odavno želi osvijestiti ljude o zločinima koje su počinili u Auschwitzu, no nema pravnih alata da podigne optužnice. Nakon što Johann Radmann i Thomas Gnielka pronađu dokumente koji vode izravno do počinitelja, Bauer odmah shvati koliko su važni te službeno istragu povjeri Radmannu. Mladi se tužitelj posve posveti tom novom zadatku te je odlučan u namjeri da sazna što se zapravo dogodilo. Ispituje svjedoke, pretražuje dokumente, osigurava dokaze i dopušta da ga slučaj toliko zaokupi da postaje slijep na sve ostalo oko sebe, čak i na Marlene Wondrak (Friederike Becht) u koju se ludo zaljubio. Radmann prelazi granice, svađa se s prijateljima, kolegama i saveznicima te sve dublje zalazi u labirint laži i krivnje u potrazi za istinom. Ali ono što će na kraju otkriti zauvijek će promijeniti cijelu zemlju. R.: Giulio Ricciarelli Ul.: Alexander Fehling (Johann Radmann), Andre Szymanski (Thomas Gnielka), Friederike Becht (Marlene Wondrak), Johannes Krisch (Simon Kirsch), Johann von Bulow (Staatsanwalt Haller)...

programme.desc: Minority mosaic - (educational film, Croatia) danced once. They still dance today. They bridged all those good, but also lead years on Kordun, dance. This is above all and above all a school of life for many young people. The leader of the Cedomir Studen ensemble points out that the mission of the ensemble is to build healthy intermediate relationships. Dancing its own and dances from other parts, it enriches its own culture and builds a wider view of the world ... / Manjinski mozaik - (obrazovni film, Hrvatska) Plesali su nekad. Plešu i danas. Plesom su premostili sve one dobre, ali i olovne godine kojih je na Kordunu uvijek bilo. Mnoge generacije mladih Srba, Hrvata i Bošnjaka s ponosom kažu da su prve korake naučili u Ansamblu narodnih igara i pjesama Vojnić. I nije to samo folklor. To je iznad svega i prije svega škola života za mnoge mlade. Voditelj Ansambla Čedomir Studen ističe da je misija Ansambla izgraditi zdrave međunacionalne odnose. Plešući svoje i plesove iz drugih krajeva, obogaćuje se vlastita kultura i izgrađuje širi pogled na svijet...

programme.title: My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation. Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

programme.title: Wild Heart S2 / Wild Heart S2
programme.desc: In the second season, after the meeting of all family members under one roof, (Yaman) reveals the real intentions (Sarhan), and faces a dangerous opponent, and he seeks to secure the future of his loved ones. / في الموسم الثاني وبعد اجتماع جميع أفراد العائلة تحت سقف واحد، يكشف (يامان) نوايا (سرحان) الحقيقية، ويواجه خصما خطيرا، فيسعى لتأمين مستقبل أحبائه.

programme.title: Birth certificate / شهادة ميلاد
programme.desc: A mother is struggling with various means to preserve her family from disintegration, after the death of the father, but facts from the distant past are revealed to fluctuate the scales and fail all plans, and warns of a fateful future. / تجاهد أم بشتى الوسائل للحفاظ على عائلتها من التفكك وذلك بعد وفاة الأب، لكن حقائق من الماضي البعيد تتكشف لتقلب الموازين وتفشل كل الخطط، وتنذر بمستقبل مشؤوم.

programme.title: Why not?! 3 / ليه لأ؟! 3
programme.desc: The events revolve around (Sherry), a divorced mother with a special relationship with her son (Yassin), but when she falls in love again, Yassin's jealousy forms an obstacle that they must overlook together. / تدور الأحداث حول (شيري)، وهي أم مطلقة تتمتع بعلاقة خاصة مع ابنها (ياسين)، ولكن عندما تقع في الحب من جديد، تشكل غيرة (ياسين) عليها عقبة يتوجب عليهما تجاوزها سويًا.

programme.title: My Name Is Farah / My Name Is Farah
programme.desc: Farah works illegally cleaning in Istanbul after escaping from Iran, then she tries to travel to France and take care of her young son, but her life turns upside down when she witnesses a murder in her workplace, then she tries to escape from the perpetrators of the crime after getting to know her. / تعمل (فرح) عاملة نظافة بشكل غير قانوني في إسطنبول بعد فرارها من إيران، ثم تحاول السفر إلى فرنسا والاعتناء بابنها الصغير، لكن تنقلب حياتها رأسًا على عقب عندما تشهد جريمة قتل في مكان عملها، ثم تحاول الهرب من مرتكبي الجريمة بعد تعرفهم عليها.

programme.title: mercy / رحمة
programme.desc: After years of suffering, (Rahma) finds herself stuck in a toxic marriage.
